summary.text: Randy Maxwell is a Republican Indiana state senator who has represented District 43 since September 2023 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He has served as CEO of Maxwell Construction since 1999.

paragraphs.text: Maxwell graduated from Indiana University, according to Ballotpedia.
The Indiana Republican Party appointed Maxwell to the District 43 seat on September 12, 2023, to replace Chip Perfect, and he was sworn in on September 28, 2023.
He defeated Joe Volk in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Byron Holland in the general election.
